translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Labaele ibu Lagese tano penego ogo
Mani Tobaiasahanda Labaele olalu íbu lowa lalu,

Asaria-o í̠na agali biabe biaga maria haru ha nogo kamele kira haru ha bialu Lagese tano Gabaelenaga andaga pobe. Puwa í̠na Gabaele ibuhondo beba ogo bamba Tobidi libuni mandagi howa gilibu winiyago mo walia halu muni ogoni mo yalu dai bibe. Ani bialu Gabaele ibubi nde dabu bialu tomo timbuni nalu kamagobi nelo mba lalu haru halu ibabe.
Í̠ manda bidegoni i̱ aba Tobidi ibu i̱ ibinidago horo ogodaguaore ibagabu halu dai bulebira lo manda bialu horo daga lalu ka.

I̱na horo mbira bolangua halu dai biruyagua nde ibunaga miniha mogolo holebira. Ani bialu bi ogodagua bulene lalu bi hongohe Laguele ibugua layagobi í̠ manda bide. I̱na bi ogoni mo wahalu ibunaga miniha genda yu nahelolebero, lene.

Ani laya handala ai Labaele halu agali mariali biaru ti pialu Lagese tano anda pialu Gabaele andaga anda pu berene. Ani biruwa Labaele ibugua muninaga beba yayago Gabaele mini Tobaiasabi wali áyu dege dabu biya lalu Gabaele ibu dabu bialu tomo timbu dawalu kamago nami̱ya ibabe laya lalu lo wini. Ani laya handala Gabaele ibugua abale puwa muni wiyadagoha handalu hearia muni biago abale nuha dagalo winidagobiore wiaria mo yalu puwa nuha honowa nogo kamele ere kunini mo paga hene.

Ani bialu egerebagiore gao layagola ti abale dabu bialu tomo narago mandagi nole manda bialu abale anda pole pene. Labaele Gabaelela Laguele andaga anda pialu hebira Tobaiasa tomo nalu berearia hendene. Ai Tobaiasahanda abale heyuwa Gabaelehondo, Ibirida, lalu mo bila hene. Ani mo bila hayagola Gabaele ibugua Tobaiasahanda bi layago ladai bialu hearia Gabaele de iba abale ibiyagola ibugua Tobaiasahondo lalu, Í̠ agali bayalebi tigabiorebi howa í̠ aba ibuni aleoredago. Ainde Anduane Homogo dahuliya andagaha haga kago ibugua í̠bi í̠ onebi libu haru mo bayale helo. Ani bialu ibugua í̠ imane wandari aba ai̱ya kirabali mo bayale helo laro. Ainde Anduane Homogohanda i̱ hameigini Tobaiasa dengui hondoliyanaga i̱ abale homa nabi helayagonaga i̱na Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini yaraga haro. Ibunaga dengui ibu abanaga denguiore handaleheda, lene.
